## CFA 05 – Dashboard API
Provides high-performance analytical data endpoints for the front-end dashboard. Retrieves all feedback from Google Sheets, performs deterministic time-window aggregation (KPI totals, sentiment breakdowns, source shares, 30-day sentiment and volume trends), computes the top 5 issue rankings, strips PII (emails) from recent items for privacy, and delivers responses with full CORS support.
